patch.value: pm get: include child rollup summary for Milestone/Epic items (GH-155)
pm get <milestone> should include children count + status rollup (aggregate --parent equivalent) inline. GitHub issue #155.

Verified already shipped (commit 4014ea69, unreleased): pm get on Milestone/Epic returns children {count,active,by_status}; calendar warning suggests pm update --deadline; pm aggregate --parent works. GH-155.
